Hi Emma / Matt —

Thanks again for the interest and for lining up your cross-functional attendees. To make this productive for everyone (AE + SE + your engineers + procurement + security), I sketched two options for a rotating demo cadence that hits reasonable overlap windows across the US / EU / APAC teams.

Quick ask: who must be on the call for the first hands-on session (technical deep-dive vs procurement intro)? Knowing that will help us pick the right time slot.

Option A — Weekday rotation (short, targeted):
- Session 1 (Americas-friendly): 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 GMT
- Session 2 (EMEA-friendly): 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 GMT
- Session 3 (APAC-friendly): 22:00 PT / 01:00 ET (next day) / 06:00 GMT (next day)

Option B — Two-slot overlap (longer, single deep-dive):
- Slot 1: 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET / 00:00 GMT (next day) — better overlap for APAC east
- Slot 2: 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 GMT — better for EMEA mornings

I attached a short agenda and a mutual action plan draft — the idea is to rotate who hosts the hands-on and to leave a standing weekly ‘handoff’ block (30m) to capture notes and unblock procurement/security.

I’ll throw up a calendar invite with 3 rotating instances once Emma/Matt confirm who needs to be present for the kickoff.

Thanks,
